From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Australian swimmer Warren Boyd Personal information Born ( 1926-12-23 ) 23 December 1926 Sydney , Australia Died 17 December 2018 (2018-12-17) (aged 91) [ 1 ] Sport Sport Swimming Strokes freestyle Club Manly Swimming Club Warren Boyd (23 December 1926 – 17 December 2018) was an Australian swimmer .
